リスニング「仕事の 3つの タイプ」の 聞く前の 1枚（`cover`）。

2026-09-04 の 指定:「リスニングの 頭に 1枚の 画像を 入れられるように」
「仕事のタイプについて 説明している ヘンディさんの 画像」
「ただし、問題の 完全な 答えとは ならないように、描写して 良いのは
 それぞれの タイプの イメージまで」。

## だから 描いては いけない もの（＝もんだいの 答え）
この STEP の 問いは **「どこで 働くか」「何を 作るか」**である。だから:
- **建物を 描かない**（お客様の 会社／自分の 会社の 区別が 見えたら 答えに なる）
- **矢印で どこかへ 行く 動きを 描かない**（SES の 答えに なる）
- **書類の 受け渡しを 描かない**（受託開発の 答えに なる）
- **カードに 字を 書かない**（SES・受託開発・自社開発 の 名前も 出さない）

描いて よいのは **雰囲気まで**——「働く 人」「みんなで 作る」「画面を 作る」の
3つの ぼんやりした 絵。順番も 本文と そろえない（当てさせない）。

ヘンディさんは 設定画（`public/img/characters/hendy/sheet.webp`）が 正典。
生成 PNG は cwebp -q 84 -blend_alpha 0xffffff で webp に する。
style: Style: warm modern anime illustration for a Japanese e-learning app — clean confident black linework, soft cel shading, bright natural daylight, friendly and welcoming. Wide banner composition. The person is drawn as a real human being with natural proportions and a warm friendly face.
noText: No text, no letters, no kanji, no kana, no numbers anywhere in the image — not on the board, not on the cards, not on any screen. The three cards carry ONLY simple wordless drawings. No watermark, no signature, no logo.
negative: Never: any readable letters or numbers, buildings or offices seen from outside, company signboards, big arrows showing someone moving from one place to another, a document being handed from one person to another, business suits with ties, anything that reveals WHERE a person works or WHICH company owns what. Also never: flat vector icon art, infographic panels, 3D render, photo realism, dark tone, angry faces, extra fingers, robots, mascots, national flags, maps.

scenes.title: 聞く前の 1枚 — ヘンディさんが「3つ ある」と 話して いる（答えは 描かない）
scenes.output: Output: one wide banner illustration, 1536x1024. The person is on the left, the board on the right, both large and close.
scenes.scene: THE ONE IDEA THIS PICTURE MUST MAKE OBVIOUS: this friendly senior engineer is about to tell you that there are THREE kinds of work — and nothing more than that. Scene: a bright, plain indoor space with a soft light wall and no windows onto any street. ON THE LEFT, drawn large: Hendy, a friendly Indonesian software engineer in his late twenties, short black hair, a light-blue casual shirt with the sleeves rolled up and NO tie, standing and turned toward the viewer, smiling warmly, one open hand raised toward the board beside him as if beginning an explanation. ON THE RIGHT: a simple light whiteboard on which THREE plain rounded cards are pinned in a row, all the same size and colour-coded only. Each card holds ONE small simple wordless drawing, deliberately vague: the first shows the silhouette of a single person standing and working at a laptop; the second shows three tiny people sitting together around a round table; the third shows a plain rectangle screen with three coloured blocks on it. The cards carry NO writing of any kind and NO buildings. Above the cards, three small blank circles are drawn as bullets — empty, with no numbers or words in them. Nothing else in the room: no desks with paperwork, no visitors, no doors, no signage. Draw hands carefully: exactly five fingers each, no tangled or merged fingers.
